changeLog.change: Registered before implementation. Audit all 77 live viewable settings (71 remaining controls plus six already consolidated payment controls), consolidate presentation by purpose and preserve stored security categories and every setting.

Expanded the preceding payment-only display taxonomy to all remaining Admin Settings categories. The existing SCAT payment contracts and six settings remain; the SCAT unknown Delivery fallback test now expects the authorised Delivery & Dispatch display category. No requirement or setting removed.

Six scoped requirements/gates verified. All 77 live controls mapped and rendered once; nine legacy/advanced controls retained. Candidate/stable each passed 31 checks; original canonical metadata/business/native snapshots retained. Current manual and deployed screenshots supplied. Production decisions unchanged.

Final review found static risk-tier badges could contradict server owner-auto-approval metadata. Reopened release acceptance to correct the card badge using the existing editor approval helper; read-only/view-only states clarified. Initial a6a5377 evidence retained separately; no business state change.

release.branchContext: lagos; canonical scope retained; dynamic/future locations and settings covered by generic mapping and tests
